ui.welcome_1: Pick a tree to start chopping. Higher levels unlock better trees, and each tree has its own mastery to 99.
ui.welcome_2: The game keeps going while the page is closed, for up to {cap}.
ui.welcome_3: Playtesting? Tap Flag at the top whenever something feels slow, fast or fun. Settings has Send playtest file.
ui.about_construction: Saw planks from logs, then build carts for the Trader, frames for the Inventor and rooms for your estate. Construction opens with the Trader.
ui.about_trader: Fill towns' orders and send caravans of your goods. Caravans bring back spices for Cooking, dye for Crafting and glass for lenses. Prices move in a cycle you can see ahead.
ui.about_estate: Rise from commoner to duke by paying gold, building rooms and proving yourself. Rooms make skills better, servants work alongside you, and the estate pays by the hour.
ui.about_workshop: Take apart things you made for parts, research blueprints, and build gadgets for your tools and machines that work alongside you.
ui.about_observatory: Six signs rise in turn. Training a skill under its sign gathers starlight; meditate with it, and with runes, for Attunement. Its rewards are time: a longer away limit, astral runes and faster crops.
ui.needs_room_workshop: The workshop is a room in your estate. Build it there to open the Inventor.
ui.needs_room_observatory: The observatory is a room in your estate. Build it there to open the sky.
ui.recipes_intro: Rare drops from enemies. Each recipe unlocks one unique food, weapon or armour in a making skill, and each needs goods from more than one skill.
ui.recipes_copy: A second copy of a recipe you know sells for gold. Recipes stay through prestige.
